title: TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote fails at base, on this branch and on origin/epic/2jn: the SIGTERM exit leaves a registry-guard temp tree behind
body: internal/cli/evacuate_signal_test.go:213 reports 'the SIGTERM exit left its temp trees behind: [ticfac-registry-guard-<n>]'. Independently reproduced in scratch worktrees at the pre-vqc base a999d400, at the vqc close commit 48abbf7f, and at origin/epic/2jn (98d68b8c), so it is not vqc's and not this attempt's — the close-out's full suite will hit it on the epic branch as it stands. It is an end-to-end test (skipped under -short), so `make gate` is green while `make test`/CI is red. The leftover name suggests the registry guard's temp root (learnings: 7ag, registrytest.GuardMain) is not released on the SIGTERM exit path. Dedup: same finding as attempt 50's, now with the epic-branch reproduction added.
